title: Matte White Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Valet Stand, 5 X 14 X 5, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Matte White, paper towel holder for kitchen countertops, 14 inches tall (14-inch, 14in) with 5 inches length x 5 inches width (5 x 14 x 5), which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy kitchens atmosphere. Freestanding, countertop paper towel stand / paper towel valet made from solid brass (brass construction) with a weighted base to prevent tipping. Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces. Contemporary, modern crisp style for a clean look on islands, prep counters, and coffee stations. No wall mount needed (freestanding design). Includes paper towel holder. Designer finish provides corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
